<table border="0" align="center" style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0">
  <tr>
    <td>
  <p>
It's possible to put a PHP file in the directory '_callbacks' that is called back at the processing of a pad tag.<br>
- With option 'before' the callback happens for every occurrence before the processing of the ocurrences.<br>
- Without 'before' the callback happens during the processing of the occurrences, as each one is processed.

</p>
</td>
  </tr>
</table>

</span><span style="color: #0000BB">$row </span><span style="color: #007700">[</span><span style="color: #DD0000">'bonus'</span><span style="color: #007700">];<br><br>        </span><span
